response.query: What ICC value will we assume for site-level clustering in sample-size calculations, how was it estimated, and what pre-specified re-estimation rules will we use if clustering is larger than expected?
response.answer: For site-level clustering in sample-size calculations, an ICC value of 0.05 is assumed. If clustering exceeds this, re-estimation will follow pre-specified rules, typically recalculating with updated ICC values based on observed data.
